message.reasoning_content:
No open description tasks. My description model is already complete. I could add a refinement: an analytic estimate to help the experimenter. Rough estimate: quantization residual per entry up to scale/2 = max|w|/14; per-row error along residual direction. Actually let me just add a small analytical note and confirmation, keeping it lightweight.

Rough math: x = 1.0*unit(direction) + 0.5*unit(residual). ||x|| ~ sqrt(1.25) ≈ 1.12. ref entries: w_row·x. direction = column-sum of W, unit; w_row·direction = (w_row · sum_rows w_row)/||sum||. Hmm ||direction||: sum of m=32 rows of 256 standard normals → norm ~ sqrt(256*32) ≈ 90.5. w_row·direction ≈ (each row contributes to sum) — roughly each row's dot with the sum ≈ sum over j of w_ij * (sum_i w_ij) which includes ||w_row||² ~ 256. So w_row·direction ≈ 256/90.5 ≈ 2.83, plus other-row contributions random ~ sqrt(256*31... actually off-diagonal ~ N(0, 255*31?) — anyway ref entries O(1-3), ||ref|| ~ sqrt(32)*~3 ~ maybe 10-20.

Error per row = x·(qw_row - w_row). qw-w residual entries iid-ish uniform-ish within ±scale/2, scale = max|w_row|/7 ~ 3.5/7 = 0.5, scale/2 ~ 0.25. Residual direction unit: residual vector r = sum_rows (qw-w), norm ~ sqrt(32*256)*0.15 ~ 44. x has 0.5*unit(r). Error row = w_row residual · x ≈ 0.5 * (row_i residual · r)/||r||. Row_i residual · r ≈ ||row_i residual||² + cross terms ≈ 256*0.02 + noise(σ≈ sqrt(256*31)*0.02... ). So error entries ~0.5*(5/44) ≈ 0.06, plus cross-term noise ~0.5*~0.5. Hmm error norm could be ~ sqrt(32)*0.5 vs ref norm ~sqrt(32)*3 → E ~ 0.15? Straddling indeed. Good — matches claim c2 range.

I'll record a modest refinement update with this analytic estimate as an open question refinement / risk note, then end.
